Who We Are

Built by industry leaders.

Tropik Media is powered by the same team behind Bling Maurice — one of Mauritius's most recognised names in digital marketing. Together, we've built over 50 brands across the island, from viral videos to high-converting paid ad campaigns.

But here's why Tropik Media exists: as our reputation grew, SMEs from retail, real estate, services, and beyond kept asking us the same thing — "We're not a restaurant. Can you help us too?"

The answer is Tropik Media. A dedicated agency built for local businesses across every sector who want an accessible, experienced, and trusted marketing partner — without the agency runaround.
